entries.partTitle: Service Mesh Architecture: Control Plane Separation, Transparent Envoy Proxy Injection & iptables Packet Interception

spec.description: Trace how istiod compiles xDS configs and Linux iptables intercepts TCP packets into Envoy sidecars.

steps.title: Castle-and-Moat Failure
steps.description: Legacy perimeter security assumes internal VPC is safe; compromised pod sniffs plaintext traffic.

steps.title: Zero-Trust Mesh Separation
steps.description: Istiod control plane streams dynamic xDS configs over gRPC to Envoy C++ sidecars.

steps.title: iptables Packet Trapping
steps.description: Istio-init configures PREROUTING and OUTPUT chains redirecting TCP to ports 15006 and 15001.

steps.title: Transparent Mesh Ingestion
steps.description: Microservices communicate normally while Envoy sidecars handle encryption and telemetry transparently.

spec.title: Mutual TLS & Cryptographic SPIFFE Identity
spec.description: Examine bidirectional X.509 authentication, automated 12-hour certificate rotation, and STRICT mode.

steps.title: Bidirectional mTLS Handshake
steps.description: Client and server Envoys present X.509 certs, verifying identities before data exchange.

steps.title: SPIFFE URI Identity
steps.description: Citadel CA issues short-lived certs with SPIFFE SANs (spiffe://cluster.local/ns/sa).

steps.title: STRICT Mode Enforcement
steps.description: STRICT PeerAuthentication terminates unencrypted plaintext with an immediate connection reset.

steps.title: Zero-Trust PKI Compliance
steps.description: Automated 12-hour rotation guarantees in-memory cryptographic freshness without downtime.

entries.partTitle: Traffic Shifting, Canary Deployments & Resilience Engineering: VirtualServices, DestinationRules & Circuit Breaking

spec.description: Analyze dynamic Layer 7 weighted routing and consecutive 5xx error outlier detection.

steps.title: Decoupled Scaling vs Routing
steps.description: DestinationRule defines v1/v2 subsets while VirtualService splits traffic by weight percentage.

steps.title: Header-Based Testing
steps.description: Beta tester headers or cookies route directly to v2 while standard users remain on v1.

steps.title: Circuit Breaker Trip
steps.description: Envoy detects 3 consecutive 5xx errors and immediately ejects the failing pod instance.

steps.title: Self-Healing Resilience
steps.description: Automatic retries and timeouts insulate upstream services from cascading outages.

steps.title: Declarative Layer 7 RBAC

steps.title: JWT Claim Verification

steps.title: Edge 403 Forbidden Drop

steps.title: Distributed Telemetry & Kiali
